summary: Keep the records that match a rule.
documentation: filter evaluates a callback for each assigned array element and creates a new array containing elements with truthy callback results. It preserves their original order.
inputs: An array and a predicate callback; thisArg is optional.
returns: A shallow copy containing matching elements.
caution: The array is new, but object elements still refer to the same objects. filter does not copy nested data.
scenarios: Show only open service requests in a dispatch dashboard.
Keep in-stock products when a customer changes a storefront filter.
Select unpaid invoices for a follow-up list.
title: Find the jobs ready to dispatch
problem: Given an array of jobs with id and status fields, return the complete job objects whose status is exactly "ready". Preserve input order.
goal: Use Array.filter() or an equivalent approach that demonstrates the same concept.
hint: Return value.filter(...) and compare each status with "ready".
